selected_branches.branch: Electric-scooter operation on a bicycle lane, subject to the ordinance exception

law_text: Except as otherwise provided in an ordinance enacted pursuant to NRS 484A.469 [DEF-LVMC-11-40-185-A], an electric scooter may be operated: On a roadway, bicycle lane, path or route at a speed of not more than 15 miles per hour.
